assessments.reasoning: Lines 72–75 of the pinned project's README expressly identify SETL4 as a SETL implementation. Lines 66–70 separately identify the earlier BALM, PL/I and LITTLE systems.

challenge.method: Compared the maintainer's numbering of implementations with the separately described SETL language and the SPITBOL sets extension beginning at line 80.
challenge.results: The numbering identifies a project implementation, and the next section supplies a SPITBOL-based surface. The implementation relationship can be read directly without relying on the neighboring surface description.

limitations: The underlying project classifies SETL4 as an implementation. Here the frozen text establishes that attribution, with conformance and source compatibility outside scope.
